headline: Public hearing on a three-lot subdivision at 34 Pingree Hill Road, plus two sign design reviews.
summary: Craig J. Bonneau Construction Company, LLC has a public hearing on a three-lot subdivision at 34 Pingree Hill Road. Other items include an escrow for 6 Old Chester Road, LLC and two sign design reviews.
